new_target: SHH-GPC1 -> Hedgehog coreceptor presentation and axon-response program
decision_basis: Primary neural studies support GPC1-dependent SHH presentation and downstream HHIP/post-crossing axon responsiveness. This recovers a bounded coreceptor function program, but not a unique intracellular relay or terminal TF.

Primary neural studies support Sema3B engagement of an NRP2/Plexin-A1 receptor complex and receptor-dependent repulsive axon-guidance output. This recovers a bounded holoreceptor function program, but not a terminal TF.

Primary studies support TIMP2 interaction with the alpha3beta1 integrin complex and SHP-1-linked anti-mitogenic or anti-angiogenic function. This recovers the complex-level program while excluding an ITGA3-only or terminal TF claim.

Primary studies support TIMP2 function through the alpha3beta1 integrin complex, which contains ITGB1, with SHP-1-linked anti-mitogenic or anti-angiogenic output. This recovers the beta1-containing complex program without treating ITGB1 as an isolated receptor.

Primary receptor studies support UCN1 binding and activation of CRHR2 isoforms with cAMP-coupled signaling. This recovers an exact receptor function program, but not a terminal TF or universal tissue response.

Primary receptor studies support the canonical UTS2-UTS2R/GPR14 ligand-receptor assignment and receptor activation. This recovers an exact GPCR function program, but not a terminal TF or universal downstream coupling.
Primary ligand and receptor studies support UTS2B/URP binding and activation of UTS2R/GPR14. This recovers an exact GPCR function program, but not a terminal TF or universal downstream coupling.
Primary binding and vascular studies support VEGF165 engagement of NRP2 and NRP2-dependent VEGFR-associated responses. This recovers an isoform- and coreceptor-bounded program, but not a terminal TF.
